title: Resolution Except for the Normal-Crossing Locus and Galois actions
summary: In characteristic zero, we construct a canonical, functorial resolution algorithm by weighted blow-ups that strictly preserves the normal crossings (nc) locus, effectively answering Kollar's problem. Operating in full generality, our approach handles both reduced and non-reduced nc singularities alongside the simple normal crossings (snc) exceptional divisor setup, terminating with a normal crossings Deligne-Mumford stack.
